description: Update the component audit cache (.a11y-cache.json) after scanning files. Stores file hashes, finding counts, severity breakdown, and scan timestamp so unchanged files can be skipped on re-audit.

cacheFile.description: Path to cache file (default: .a11y-cache.json in project root)

entries.description: Array of scan results to cache

filePath.description: Absolute path to the scanned file

findingCount.description: Number of accessibility findings in this file

useContentHash.description: Use SHA-256 content hash instead of size+mtime. Default: false

name: update_audit_cache

path.description: A file this call wrote or read, when there is one.

version.description: Version of an external tool, when relevant.

title: Update Audit Cache
